title: Distance-Weighted Norm Equivalences for Analytic Functions on John Domains
summary: Let $Ω\subset\mathbb C$ be a bounded John domain and set $δ(z)=\text{dist}(z,\partialΩ)$. For $1 \text{dim}_A(\partialΩ)-2$, we establish a norm equivalence between $\int_Ω|g|^pδ^α\,dA$ and $\int_Ω|g'|^pδ^{α+p}\,dA$ for analytic functions $g$ on $Ω$, with a point-evaluation term fixing the additive constant. The estimate of the derivative term is local and holds on every proper planar domain, whereas the converse follows from a distance-weighted Poincaré inequality on John domains.
